'''Weyl''' is an NPC that sometimes appears in [[TD Observatory]], [[Black Shores Archipelago]] during the daytime (06.00 AM - 05.59 PM). He works for both [[Black Shores]] and [[Lollo Logistics]] as a courier, handling package shipments to and from the organization.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Weyl:''' All the supplies are here. Now, what's next...
:'''Weyl:''' Hm? Oh, hi there. I'm Weyl, with Lollo Logistics. Got a package to send?
:{{DIcon}} Lollo Logistics can even send packages to the Black Shores?
:'''Weyl:''' Absolutely. Wherever our clients are, we make sure their packages get delivered safe and sound.
:'''Weyl:''' I handle all the shipments to and from the Black Shores. If you have any issues with deliveries or transportation routes, just let me know anytime.
:{{DIcon}} So that's how the Black Shores gets its supplies.
::'''Weyl:''' Not everything comes this way, but yeah, Lollo Logistics is working with the Black Shores.
:{{DIcon}} But how did you get onto this island?
::'''Weyl:''' By ship, I assume.
::{{DIcon}} ...That's not what I meant.
::{{DIcon}} And how do the ships even find this place?
::'''Weyl:''' Haha, just messing with you. But honestly, I can't share that—it's a company secret.
:'''Weyl:''' No offense, but is there some misunderstanding here? Oh, I forgot to wear my Blake Bloom. No wonder you're asking all these questions.
:'''Weyl:''' I'm also a Black Shores Consultant, but I usually don't wear the Blake Bloom outside this island.
:{{DIcon}} Why not? It's convenient.
:'''Weyl:''' Most places are indeed accommodating to Consultants, but some people aren't too happy with us. They even disconnected the local Nexus from the Tethys System.
:'''Weyl:''' Since the Black Shores isn't exactly popular everywhere, it's better to go low-profile when delivering. People tend to open up more that way, too.
:{{DIcon}} Makes sense.
:'''Weyl:''' Anyway, I've got to check the inventory. If you have any packages to send, just come find me.
{{Dialogue End}}
